_notes: Default 3 potion slots (+2 with Bottle Rack). Shop price 45-64 gold x (1 + 0.15 x (act-1)).
Drop: Elites always drop a potion; normal fights 50%. No potions with Cracked Flask.

potions.name: Healing Draught
potions.description: Heal 20 HP (+10 per Act after the first). Usable anywhere.

potions.name: Volatile Flask
potions.description: Deal 20 damage to the target (×Act number).

potions.name: Mighty Brew
potions.description: Gain 3 Might (+2 per Act after the first).

potions.name: Purge Salts
potions.description: Cleanse all tile debuffs and your Poison.

potions.name: Phoenix Feather
potions.description: Keep it in a slot. When you would die, it burns and brings you back with 30% HP. It can't be drunk.

potions.name: Fresh Pages
potions.description: Discard your whole hand and draw a fresh 16 tiles.

potions.name: Venom Vial
potions.description: Inflict 8 Poison on the target (+4 per Act after the first).

potions.name: Blast Jar
potions.description: Deal 12 damage to ALL enemies (+6 per Act after the first).

potions.name: Shatter Draught
potions.description: Inflict Broken 3 on ALL enemies (+50% damage taken).

potions.name: Jester's Brew
potions.description: Add 2 Fragile [ ? ] Wildcard tiles to your hand (or your discard pile if your hand is full).

potions.name: Battle Cry
potions.description: Add 3 Fragile [ ! ] tiles to your hand (or your discard pile if your hand is full).

potions.name: Vanishing Powder
potions.description: Escape a normal or Elite fight. You get no reward. Doesn't work on bosses.

potions.name: Ancient Fruit
potions.description: Raise your Max HP by 5 and heal 5. Usable anywhere.

potions.name: Echo Draught
potions.description: The next word you cast this turn has its output doubled.

potions.name: Clarity Draught
potions.description: Every tile in your hand becomes Level 2 for this combat.
